action.command: echo "=== FATAL/SEVERE in Tomcat logs ==="; for t in dienste anwendung api; do echo "-- $t --"; grep -iE "SEVERE|FATAL|OutOfMemory|BeanCreationException|Context.*failed|org.springframework.beans.Fatal" /opt/tomcat-$t/logs/catalina.out 2>/dev/null | tail -3; done; echo "=== startup 'Server startup' lines ==="; for t in dienste anwendung api; do grep -hE "Server startup in" /opt/tomcat-$t/logs/catalina.out 2>/dev/null | sed "s/^/$t: /"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
